title: Trend AI Cleaner One Pro Link Following Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of TrendLife Cleaner One Pro. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Junk Files Cleanup functionality. By creating a junction, an attacker can abuse the service to delete arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete files in the context of SYSTEM.
